app: Brewly — coffee shop ordering, with food & snacks, rewards/loyalty, order tracking, wishlist. Persona shown: Ayesha Khan. Currency: USD ($).
ctaRules: Primary CTA is a full-width dark-green pill; the '→' arrow appears ONLY on the hero ('Get Started →') and checkout ('Proceed to Checkout →') — other primaries ('Add to Cart →' on detail is the board's one further exception, beside the stepper) carry it sparingly, never as decoration on secondary actions.
Selection state is the brand green itself: selected chip, selected size segment and active tab are all dark-green fill/text — no second selection colour.
Secondary actions are text links (Log In, See All, View Details) or icon buttons in circles (call/chat on the courier row) — never a second filled button competing with the primary.
On a dark-green field the CTA inverts: the rewards 'Redeem' is a light/white pill inside the green hero card.
Destructive/quiet exits stay quiet: Log Out is a separated light pill, cart delete is a header trash icon — neither uses the primary green.
density: Comfortable medium: list rows ~64px, 4–5 rows per screen; home airier; tracker and rewards information-dense but chunked into cards.
deviations: vs reference_profile.mjs measurement: pixels rank archetype neutral-gallery (85) over committed-field (60) and call the modal hue orange — photography-weighted. The decode shows flat UI fields are dark-green committed fields. RESOLUTION RULE (REFERENCE_INGEST.md): the decode governs art/design direction; the measurement governs only measured colour numbers. The override and its reason are recorded here, not hidden.

vs base reference: dedicated loyalty/rewards pattern (points hero + earn rows + unlock offer) — the base decodes flag this as MISSING in the engine; a Brewly-governed plan must plan it as a gap, not silently substitute the wallet.
vs base reference: tracker carries a map-with-route + courier contact row; the base tracker pattern alone does not include them (flagged MISSING in the source decode).
vs base reference: detail carries a paid add-on checkbox group and a size segmented control with per-size prices — distinct sub-patterns on top of the base detail sheet.
vs base reference: wishlist is a LIST view reusing the product list row (the sneaker board's wishlist is a grid) — both forms exist across references; this reference governs the list form.
Serif display type is confined to the onboarding hero headline; the base default of sans display must yield to this on the hero screen only.
headerRules: Secondary screens: back chevron left + centred title + one right icon (search, bag, or trash on cart; none on tracker).
Home has NO centred title: greeting block left ('Good Morning,' + persona name) with circular avatar right.
Profile header is a dark-green colour field carrying avatar + name + email in white, with the rewards card overlapping its bottom edge.
Onboarding hero has no header and no tab bar: brand lockup top-left over the photo.
Photo headers (detail) put back/bag actions in white circles over the image.
navModel: 5-tab bottom bar — Home, Menu, Orders (centre, cart-emphasised), Wishlist, Profile; line icons + labels, active in dark green. Present on 7+ of 10 screens; absent only on the hero.
